answer: The best chain on garnet is QB7-QB12-QB11, with QB12 in the middle. The default calibration set is f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade. The IRB CZ fidelity of QB12-QB7 is 0.998016 and the fidelity of QB12-QB11 is 0.998693. Their product is 0.996712. The second-best chain is QB12-QB11-QB16 at 0.994689. I checked all 28 CZ pairs, and all 28 had IRB values. I ran a native 3-qubit GHZ circuit on garnet:mock as job 01a15fa0-538a-7391-9617-da35dbdfaeb7 with 200 shots. The circuit used PRX gates, CZ(QB12,QB7) and CZ(QB12,QB11), and one measurement of QB7, QB12, QB11 in that order under key "m". The job completed. The counts were 000: 51, 001: 48, 110: 42, 111: 59. These counts are not a real GHZ signal. The mock backend returns random results.
